title: Newly Taken Valuables Cover: Time Held at the Current HostCover Level
content:
For a valuables claim under **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)**, the valuables new-cover share follows how long the plan had held its current HostCover level when the stay checked in, counted in calendar days from the plan's last level change (or from its enrollment when the level was never changed) to the date the host service fee was assessed on the stay: fewer than 90 days settles the valuables at 50 percent, 90 to 364 days at 75 percent, and 365 days or more in full. The percentage applies to the valuables loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

## Reading the dates

- **Start date**: the HostCover plan's last level change date; if the level was never changed, the plan's enrollment date.
- **End date**: the date the host service fee was assessed on the stay the loss arose from, as recorded in Host Accounts.
- **Days held**: calendar days from the start date to the end date.

| Days held | Valuables settled at |
|---|---|
| 0 to 89 | 50 percent |
| 90 to 364 | 75 percent |
| 365 or more | in full |

## Day-count illustration (hypothetical plan whose level was last changed on 2025-11-01)

| Host service fee assessed on the stay | Days held | Settled at |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-29 | 89 | 50 percent |
| 2026-01-30 | 90 | 75 percent |
| 2026-10-31 | 364 | 75 percent |
| 2026-11-01 | 365 | in full |

A plan never moved off the level it was enrolled at counts from its enrollment date in the same way.
